summary: Marked bays in a rugby club car park, trees and fields around.
reasons: Club car park with playing fields beside

best_section.where: Bays at the north-east end of the lower car park, beside the club pavilion

drivers.seclusion: Playing fields to the east, dense trees to the south and the club pavilion to the north; nearest apartments are over 40 m away beyond trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays, reached from Sylvan Road by a tree-lined driveway; no gate seen. Room to pull into a bay.
drivers.traffic: Sylvan Road is busy but screened by trees; club traffic at events.
drivers.convention: Car park full of cars through the day, so a van blends in.

flags: Sylvan Road has No Stopping signs 6-9am Mon-Fri near the driveway mouth, not in the bays
Low-lying, about 5 m elevation, no mapped waterway
Steep: up to 8.2% grade on the driveway, bays about 0.5%
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the south and west edges.
